title: Tunisian-Style Date Tagine
description: A sweet and savory stew originating from Tunisia, made with dates and a blend of spices. Perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: winey
ingredients.notes: red wine or dry white wine

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the crunchy and cook until lightly toasted, about 3 minutes.
Add the dates and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tunisian spice blend, winey, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional crunchy and dates if desired.
